user_query: I'm planning a family vacation and I need your assistance. Can you find me the best hotels in Hawaii? Additionally, I would like to calculate the Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) for each family member to plan our meals.

TaskList.description: Search for the best hotels in Hawaii based on family-friendly amenities and customer reviews.
Collect personal details for each family member to calculate BMR, such as age, weight, height, and gender.
Calculate the Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) for each family member using the collected data.
